description: Update an existing DNS record on an Impreza-managed domain. Locate the record by `type` + `host` + `old_value`, and supply `new_value`.

host.description: Record name/host of the record to change.

old_value.description: Current value of the record (used to locate it).

type.description: Record type of the record to change.

name: impreza_update_dns_record
